name: What kind of warranty comes with new windows?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty comes with new windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most new windows come with a manufacturer's warranty that covers defects in materials and workmanship, often ranging from 10 years to a limited lifetime. The specifics, such as coverage for glass, frames, or hardware, vary by manufacturer. Additionally, as your contractor, we provide a warranty on our installation labor. We will review all warranty details with you during the selection process so you understand the protection for your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: New windows typically come with a manufacturer's warranty for materials and workmanship, plus a separate labor warranty from the installer.
